    The Dallas Stars play the Minnesota Wild in Game 2 of the Western Conference First Round tonight, Monday, April 20, 2026, at 8:30 p.m. CT at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, following a 6-1 loss in Game 1. The game can be streamed on FanDuel Sports North/ESPN or heard on KFAN. 
    Key Game 2 Details: 
    • Matchup: Minnesota Wild vs. Dallas Stars (Series: MIN 1-0)
    • Time: 8:30 PM CT (April 20, 2026)
    • Location: American Airlines Center, Dallas, TX
    • Stars Injuries: Roope Hintz is out until at least Game 4.
    • Context: The Stars are looking to bounce back after a 6-1 loss in Game 1, having a 6-2 record in Game 2 following a playoff Game 1 loss.
